about: Values used on the GF drawings that are NOT defined in the frozen master Rev3.0_GlassFront_params.json (GF-2.0; first written for GF-1.1): reference data quoted from the research reports R1/R2 and the concept, jig design values, inspection limits and drafting choices. Each item is a judgement call for the lead to confirm; drawings_report.json lists which drawing uses which item. Product geometry (glass, cut-out, lip, holes, strips, pips, fasteners) is never taken from here.

items.name: qty_glass
items.source: lead brief; R2 sec. 6 (100 ovens + 10 % spares)

items.name: min_hole_to_cutout
items.source: concept sec. 11.4 rule 'to cut-out edge (>= 8)'; R2 sec. 2.4 item 3 (PEM 7.2, design to 8)
items.note: centre of a hole / stud to the cut-out edge

items.name: sheet_general_tol
items.source: judgement (common sheet-metal practice)

items.name: stud_perpendicularity_deg
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D01, round 3): no source states one. 16 x tan 1 deg = 0.28 at the tip of the M4 x 16 stud; with the +-0.3 axis position that is 0.58 < 0.70 radial clearance of the M4 stud across the 5.4 slot. 2 deg (0.56 at the tip) would use the whole clearance.

items.name: display_px
items.source: R1 sec. 3.3 step 7 (1 px = 0.1926 x 0.179 mm); concept sec. 4.3

items.name: section_u
items.source: drafting: typical edge section A-A on the top edge at u = -25, clear of F1 and the pips

items.name: ink_black
items.value: RAL 9005 / Pantone Black 6 C, optical density OD >= 4 at 550 nm, no pin-holes visible on a 1000 lx light box
items.source: R2 sec. 1.3; R1 sec. 4.3

items.name: ink_tests
items.value: cross-cut ISO 2409 (1 mm grid) GT0-1 dry and after 1 h in boiling water; silicone bead peel coupon >= 90 % cohesive failure (7 d cure, again after 7 d 70 C / 95 % RH); LOCA cure-inhibition coupon (fully cured, tack-free) per ink lot
items.source: R1 sec. 4.3 and 3.3 step 4

items.name: glass_standards

value.thermal: EN 12150-1 (thermally toughened soda-lime safety glass), fragmentation test per EN 12150-1
value.chemical_sl: EN 12337-1 (chemically strengthened soda-lime glass); CS >= 450 MPa, DOL >= 10 um
value.chemical_as: aluminosilicate cover glass (no EN): CS >= 700 MPa, DOL >= 35 um

items.source: R1 sec. 4.6, R2 sec. 1.2 and 1.4 (CS/DOL values); EN 12337-1 named by the drafter

items.name: enamel_strength
items.source: R1 sec. 4.3: EN 12150-1 minimum bending strength 75 MPa for enamelled toughened glass (120 for float)

items.name: glass_cosmetic

value.window_A: no visible scratch; points <= 0.10 ignore, 0.10-0.20 max 2 per piece >= 20 apart, > 0.20 reject
value.border_B: seen from the front: no pin-hole, no clear spot, no ink voids; ink edge raggedness at the window <= 0.10; scratch <= 0.05 wide x 5 long max 2
value.edge: no chips > 0.3 seen from the front; shells on the back face <= 0.5 x 0.5

items.source: judgement (R2 sec. 1.3 asks for cosmetic limits, values by the drafter)

items.name: glass_sampling
items.value: outline: every piece (go/no-go gauge); thickness and flatness: 5 per lot; ink tests: per ink lot; fragmentation (thermal only): 1 sacrificial piece per tempering lot
items.source: judgement

items.name: j1_parallel

items.name: j1_opening_margin

items.name: j2_checks
items.value: 0.05 feeler must not enter between the lip top and the plate at 8 points; g2 by feeler at 20 C within the gap acceptance limits (this sheet)
items.source: concept sec. 6 step 6; limits from gap_acceptance (lead round-3 addition D)

items.name: gap_acceptance

corners.en: not smaller than the adjacent sides, at most 0.80
corners.tr: komşu kenarlardan küçük değil, en fazla 0,80

items.source: lead round-3 addition D (replaces the old corner limits g2 0.40-0.60 / g1 0.35-0.65 and the side limits g2 0.30-0.50 / g1 0.25-0.55). Drafter's worst-case stack, part centred, per side: g2 0.40 +- (glass/2 + lip/2) = 0.30-0.50 with glass +-0.1 (0.25-0.55 with +-0.2), lip outline +-0.1 on size [P]; g1 0.40 +- (cut-out/2 + lip/2) = 0.30-0.50 with cut-out +-0.1. Shim-rule centring adds up to (total - 2 x 0.30)/2 per side when the total clearance exceeds 0.65

items.name: mount_procedure
items.value: IPA-wipe the sheet back (VHB primer on powder coat if required), remove the liner, apply the corner dabs, lower the module from behind (lip into the cut-out, studs through the slots), centre with 8 PTFE shims in g1 ({shims}), press about 1 kN (about 100 kPa on the tape) for 30 s, washers + nyloc nuts crosswise, remove the shims; keep a pressure frame on >= 20 min
items.source: concept sec. 6 'Mounting' and sec. 11.5 (spring-back); shims: master jig_and_mounting_shims.sheet_mounting_shims + shim_rule (round 4), replacing the single 0.30

items.name: flush_check
items.value: dial gauge on a bridge, 12 points round the cut-out: glass and lip vs steel within +-0.15; g1 by feeler at 20 C within the gap acceptance limits (this sheet); recheck the 4 mid-edges after 24 h
items.source: concept sec. 6 'Inspection'; limits from gap_acceptance (lead round-3 addition D)

items.name: cure
items.value: 2-C: 1-2 h in the jig (1-2 jigs for 100); 1-C: 24 h (about 5 jigs)
items.source: concept sec. 6 step 5

items.source: lead brief (first batch)

items.source: judgement: first samples for approval; printed ink coupons per ink lot (R2 RFQ asks 5 samples)

items.source: judgement: J1 glass stops only place the glass inside the XY range

items.name: j2_pin_detail
items.unit: mm (pin proud tol, pin chamfer x 45 deg, stop-hole depth, stop-pin length)
items.source: judgement

items.name: print_rim_max
items.source: round-1 finding M2 / lead round-2 correction 5: ink cannot lie on the 0.3-0.5 x 45 deg face-2 arris; allowed unprinted rim = arris max, measured from the outline

items.name: frame_lip_outline_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50): +-0.1 on the lip inner (recess) and lip outer outline sizes, +-0.1 on their corner radii; the design document names only TG5, which is too loose for the 0.4 gaps (g1 / g2 budget +-0.09 / +-0.12 RSS per side, concept 5.2)

items.name: frame_lip_width_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50): lip width 1.0 nominal +-0.05 (no tolerance in any source)

items.name: frame_slot_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50): slot 5.4 +0.1/0 x 7.0 +-0.1 (a dia 4.8 rivet must pass and still be located; position +-0.1 is in the master)

items.name: frame_cb_tol
items.unit: mm (size +, size -, floor depth +, floor depth -)
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50): counterbore size +0.2/0 and floor depth +0.2/0 - the weld-stud flange (dia 5.3-5.7 x 0.7-1.4, + paint) must never touch

items.name: frame_tube_top_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50): tube tops (washer / rivet seats) +-0.1 to datum A

items.name: frame_core_r_in_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50): coring groove inner radius r_in +0/-0.1 - a larger r_in shrinks the dia-12.4 washer seat inside the groove (master washer_nut note: 80.7 mm2 centred, 65.9 at the slot end; cad_rules: the M5 rivet washer does not bridge the groove)

items.name: frame_boss_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50): PCB boss tops H1-H9 coplanar 0.1 and +-0.1 to datum A (v2 has no stated tolerance; v2 general TG5)

items.name: frame_lip_texture
items.value: lip top and lip outer face: plain mould finish, black (material colour, no paint); texture VDI 3400 Ref 24 as a priced option (the owner's decision on the lip finish, design document section 4)
items.source: concept sec. 4.6; design document section 4 (the owner's decision on the lip finish)

items.name: j2_tail_holder
items.unit: mm (post dia g6 in a H7 hole, hole depth, post centre beyond the flange bottom edge, post height, clip height range above the plate)
items.source: GF-2.0 judgement (concept_gf2.md 5.3 'a removable post with a clip or a Kapton tab', risk 3 'J2 tail holder'): removable steel post at u 0 on the tail side of the plate, swing arm with a spring clip (PTFE-faced jaws) that holds the top of the tail guide card over the bend-gap slot line; the arm swings away while the frame is threaded on and back once the card is through the slot

items.name: j2_tail_card
items.unit: mm (card thickness, width, card top and bottom above the plate, Kapton tab width, lowest tab height above the plate)
items.source: GF-2.0 judgement: PET (or PEEK) guide card on the PANEL side of the vertical tails (so the 0.70 tail -> bridge face clearance is not used up), bottom above both bends and above the panel back, top above the TFT tail end; tails tacked to it with polyimide (Kapton) tape tabs only above the frame back (>= 25 above the plate) so the tabs can be peeled from behind once the frame is down; the stiff card finds the 3.0 slot when the frame is threaded on

items.name: tg_gauge
items.unit: mm (gauge depth away from the panel, end-pad length, material, slot +/-, nose R +-, height +-, base flatness, nose Ra um)
items.source: GF-2.0 judgement for GF-D21 (concept_gf2.md 2.4 item 6: 'fold both tails over a 3.0 mm gauge block held against the panel edge (with an R1.5 edge)'): end pads touch the panel edge face outside the tail span so the gauge forms the 3.0 bend-gap slot with the panel edge; its height = the land-plate back above the CTP front (bridge nose height); POM so the tails cannot be scratched; tolerance +0.02/0 so a passing tail never passes only because the gauge is small

items.name: tg_test
items.unit: fold / unfold cycles, minutes held folded, inspection magnification x, exit-height band (mm) inside which the route is insensitive
items.source: GF-2.0 judgement (GF-D21 test steps): 3 gentle cycles and 5 min held folded before the lift / bond inspection at 10x; exit height band +-0.3 = concept_gf2.md 2.3 tolerance case 'exit Z +-0.3' (clearance change < 0.2) - beyond it the clearances are to be re-checked

items.name: frame_bend_face_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50, GF-2.0): bridge pocket face y 122.00 +-0.05 to datum B. +0.05 keeps bead -> face >= 1.04 (master bead_pocket_min 1.0 against the nominal 1.09); -0.05 takes 0.05 of the 0.45 tail clearance in g_bend

items.name: frame_nose_R_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50, GF-2.0): nose R1.5 +0.2/0 - never smaller (master bend_nose_R note: a pulled tail must never be bent tighter than tail_R_in_min); larger only shortens the 1.0 flat of the pocket face

items.name: frame_land_break_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL [P] (GF-D50, GF-2.1): land break 0.3 +0.05 / -0.10 x 45 deg. The bead -> break-edge margin is only 0.060 (1.06 on the land plane against A1 bead_pocket_min 1.0, master open_findings.margins_note_GF-2.1): a 0.05 larger break leaves 1.01, a +-0.1 band would let the bead come to 0.96; a smaller break only adds margin. For the owner's decision

items.name: frame_rib_pos_tol
items.source: PROPOSAL (GF-D50, GF-2.0): divider rib position +-0.2 (2.85 to each tail edge, master div_x note); thickness and heights per TG5
